project.title: Calcineurin-regulated Phosphopeptide(30 min) and CaN-regulated dephosphopeptide(10 min) researchs in Pheromone gland of  Helicoverpa armigera
project.projectDescription: Calcineurin-regulated Phosphopeptide(30 min) and CaN-regulated dephosphopeptide(10 min) researchs used Itraq method in Pheromone gland of Helicoverpa armigera
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: Newly-emerged females were first decapitated, and then maintained for 24 hours. PGs were collected from the decapitated females and incubated at room temperature with Grace’s Insect Medium containing 5 μM cyclosporine A. After 1 h waiting time, medium was replaced with fresh Grace’s Insect Medium containing 10 pmol PBAN and 5 μM CysA. samples were collected after 30 min of PBAN treatment, samples were subjected to Protein extraction. Control females were incubated  without CysA.          Newly emerged females were decapitated, and maintained for 24 h to remove endogenous PBAN. PGs were then dissected and incubated with Grace’s Insect   Medium (containing 5 μM cyclosporine A). After 1 h of incubation, the medium were replaced by the fresh Grace’s Insect Medium containing 5 μM CysA and 10 pmol PBAN. PG samples were collected after 10 min of PBAN incubation, and samples were subjected to Protein extraction. Control females were incubated without calcineurin inhibitor.         All samples were homogenized in lysis buffer (4% SDS, 1 mM DTT, 150 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0, protease inhibitor). After 3 min incubation in boiling water, the homogenate was sonicated on ice. The crude extract was then incubated in boiling water again and clarified by centrifugation at 16000 x g at 25°C for 10 min. Protein content was determined with the BCA protein assay reagent (Beyotime). The supernatants were stored at -80℃ until use.
project.dataProcessingProtocol: MS/MS spectra were searched using MASCOT engine (Matrix Science, London, UK; version 2.2) embedded into Proteome Discoverer 1.4 (Thermo Electron,   San Jose, CA.)against RNA-seq  database. For protein identification, the following options were used. Peptide mass tolerance=20 ppm, MS/MS tolerance=0.1 Da, Enzyme=Trypsin, Missed cleavage=2, Fixed modification: Carbamidomethyl (C), iTRAQ8plex (K), iTRAQ8plex (N-term), Variable modification: Oxidation (M),  Phosphorylation (S/T/Y), FDR ≤0.01.           The phosphorylation peptides were analyzed using Proteome Discoverer 1.3 (Thermo Electron, San Jose, CA.). pRS score above 50 indicate a good PSM (Peptide Spectrum Matches) and pRS probabilities above 75 percent indicate that a site is truly phosphorylated.

references.referenceLine: Du M, Liu X, Ma N, Liu X, Wei J, Yin X, Zhou S, Ada R, Song Q, An S. Calcineurin-mediated dephosphorylation of acetyl-coA carboxylase is required for PBAN-induced sex pheromone biosynthesis in Helicoverpa armigera. Mol Cell Proteomics. 2017
